total_debt.note: Face value of long-term debt $84.0B (carrying $80.9B) at 2026-09-30, incl. $25B May 2026 notes. Excludes ~$15B USD notes (Nov 3) and ~EUR9B (~$10B) euro notes (closed ~Nov 12) issued after quarter-end, and operating lease liabilities ($31.2B).

capex.note: Purchases of PP&E $33.9B + finance lease principal $1.0B.

free_cash_flow.note: S&P (negative outlook) projects free operating cash flow deficits of ~$22B (2026), $71B (2027), $39B (2028).

q3_2026_income.note: Operating income cut by $9.89B legal charge (Aug 2026 multistate AG agreement); 2026 total expense guide $175-179B.

off_balance_items.description: Non-cancelable contractual commitments (servers, network, data center/energy, cloud compute capacity incl. CoreWeave, Nebius, Google, Oracle contracts); ~$45.85B due rest of 2026 and $121.41B in 2027.
off_balance_items.counterparty: Suppliers incl. CoreWeave, Nebius, Google Cloud, Oracle, Nvidia/hardware vendors

off_balance_items.description: Additional contingent obligations to purchase up to $14.72B of cloud capacity over five years (consistent with Nebius' $15B 'unsold capacity' option). Not in the $454.5B.
Operating and finance leases signed but not yet commenced: data centers, energy infrastructure, colocations and network infrastructure, commencing rest of 2026 through 2036, terms >1 to 30 years.
off_balance_items.counterparty: Data center developers/JVs (incl. Hyperion/Beignet), energy, colo providers

off_balance_items.description: Maximum residual value guarantees (RVGs) to unconsolidated data-center JVs (Hyperion/Beignet with Blue Owl, plus others). Meta says payment is not probable; carried at ~zero.
off_balance_items.counterparty: Blue Owl/Beignet Investor LLC and other data center JVs

off_balance_items.description: Total maximum exposure to loss in unconsolidated data-center ventures: $68.40B (up 49% from $45.95B at YE2025) = equity carrying value $4.73B + lease commitments $18.48B + future funding commitments $3.70B + RVGs $41.49B. Includes new July 2026 Texas JV (Meta 20%, ~$14B development cost).
off_balance_items.counterparty: Data center JVs (Hyperion, Texas JV, others)

off_balance_items.description: Hyperion (Louisiana, ~5GW): Blue Owl funds own 80%, Meta 20%; SPV Beignet Investor issued ~$27.3B of bonds (PIMCO anchor) kept off Meta's balance sheet. Meta leases the campus (lease reported to start June 2029) and provides an RVG (reported capped near ~$28B) if it doesn't renew. Counted inside the $68.4B above; not summed separately.
off_balance_items.counterparty: Blue Owl / Beignet Investor LLC / PIMCO bondholders
off_balance_items.source_title: Global Data Center Hub: Hyperion financing

off_balance_items.description: Meta is a RECIPIENT of vendor/structured financing: Blue Owl JV equity (~$23B per GDCH) and SPV debt fund Hyperion; Meta took ~$3B one-time distribution. Separately, CoreWeave's $8.5B DDTL 4.0 is backstopped by its Meta contract, i.e., Meta's commitments are collateral for neocloud debt.
off_balance_items.source_title: Global Data Center Hub; MeasuredAI neocloud report

off_balance_items.description: Meta as a concentrated BUYER of neocloud capacity: CoreWeave ~$35B total (14.2B Sept 2025 + $21B Apr 2026 through 2032); Nebius up to $27B (Mar 2026: $12B dedicated + up to $15B); Oracle ~$20B (Oct 2025); Google TPU rental multi-billion (Feb 2026). These neoclouds are debt-financed against Meta's contracts. Presumed inside the $454.5B commitments; not summed.

New Mexico court ordered Meta to pay $25B civil penalty (Oct 21, 2026) with 15% annual interest pending appeal; Meta appealing. 10-Q references accrual for loss contingencies; accrual status of full amount unclear.
off_balance_items.source_title: Reuters: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion penalty

off_balance_items.description: New Class C (non-voting) common stock via one-time 1:1 stock dividend (effective ~Jan 19, 2027), explicitly to support capital raising, compensation and acquisitions while preserving Zuckerberg's control — sets up future equity funding of AI capex.

total_note: Sum: non-cancelable commitments $454.52B + leases not yet commenced $355.73B + JV residual value guarantees $41.49B + JV future funding commitments $3.70B = $855.44B. Excluded to avoid double counting: JV lease commitments $18.48B (assumed within uncommenced leases), JV equity $4.73B (already a balance-sheet asset), Hyperion $27.3B (inside the $68.4B JV exposure), named cloud contracts ~$82B (inside the $454.5B), $14.72B contingent cloud purchases (contingent), $25B New Mexico judgment (litigation, under appeal). Off-balance total is ~6.5x annualized Q3 operating cash flow (~$131B) and ~10x debt face value.

credit_signals.detail: Aa3 senior unsecured, stable; assigned to Nov 2026 notes, expecting conservative financial policy and positive net cash.
AA-, outlook revised to NEGATIVE (late Oct 2026). S&P projects FOCF deficits of ~$22B/$71B/$39B for 2026-2028 and leverage of 1.1x (2027) and 1.3x (2028), above its 1.0x downgrade threshold.
~EUR8.25-9B six-tranche debut euro deal (4.30%-6.40% coupons, to 2065); Meta paid ~1.4x Alphabet's euro spreads.
$25.0B fixed-rate senior notes in six series maturing 2031-2066, 4.55%-6.45%.
Beignet Investor ~$27.3B bonds priced ~140bp over Meta's own curve; reports the bonds hit record low price in Sept 2026.

hidden_leverage_assessment.rationale: On paper Meta has only ~$84B of debt and ~$82B of cash, so a balance-sheet scorecard says it's fine. But it has signed ~$356B of data-center/energy leases that haven't started yet, ~$455B of non-cancelable purchase commitments (including big neocloud contracts with CoreWeave, Nebius, Oracle and Google), and guarantees up to $41.5B of residual value on JVs like Hyperion, where Blue Owl and bondholders put up ~$27B that never shows up as Meta debt. That's roughly $855B of obligations versus maybe ~$130B a year of operating cash flow, at a moment when free cash flow is already negative, buybacks are zero, S&P has a negative outlook, and a $25B court penalty is pending. It isn't Severe because ads revenue still grows 26% and Meta can still borrow at AA-level rates, but it's the most structurally off-balance-sheet hyperscaler.
hidden_leverage_assessment.biggest_hidden_risk: If AI returns disappoint and Meta wants to cut back, the $356B of signed leases and Hyperion-style residual value guarantees mean it can't easily walk away, so the 'flexible' capex is really fixed, debt-like spending.
hidden_leverage_assessment.what_would_change_my_mind: Seeing Meta return to positive FCF in 2027 while S&P moves back to stable and the uncommenced-lease and JV exposure totals stop growing would drop this to Elevated.
